```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```




```{r}
library(tidyverse)

source("source/sim_mean_sd.R")

set.seed(1236)
```




## Mean and SD

Can we check CLT using simulations

```{r}
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
```

let's do this but keep track of results

```{r}
output = vector("list", length = 1000)

for (i in 1:1000) {
  
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
  
}
```

inspect results

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean), 
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) + 
  geom_density()
```



let's do this using tibbles and map instead!

```{r}
sim_results_df = 
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```


look at results

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```



## change `n`

```{r}
sim_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240), 
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mean)) +
  geom_violin()
```


look at the numbers

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  group_by(samp_size) |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean), 
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```
